integrity: All findings concern a self-contained finite-dimensional operator-norm statement proved by a two-node interpolation identity and a scalar maximizing witness. Originality is an evidence-based comparison, not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the degree-two homogeneous complex-bidisk block with the first two monomials retained; no higher-degree, real-target or arbitrary-compact-domain assertion. Vector-valued extremizers not exhaustively classified. Older equivalent nomenclature and inaccessible complete source texts remain publication-priority risks. The exact analytic proof does not depend on finite tests.
title: Exact first partial-section norm of homogeneous bidisk quadratics, with universal Banach-valued sharpness
